name: Wiktionary
tagline: Multilingual dictionary and thesaurus via MediaWiki API
description: Public MediaWiki API for Wiktionary providing dictionary definitions, translations, etymology, and linguistic data across many languages. Query page content, parse wikitext, search terms, and access structured extracts without a paid account.

auth.details: No API key required for read-only public requests. Optional MediaWiki account/OAuth for authenticated or write actions; identify clients with a descriptive User-Agent.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for public read access; no paid API plans

use_cases: look up a word definition in English Wiktionary
fetch translations of a term across languages
get page extract text for a lemma
check if a word page exists on Wiktionary
